scenarios.name: plains-gather-v2-1
scenarios.goal: Gather four oak logs.

scenarios.name: birch-forest-progression-v2-2
scenarios.goal: Smelt the raw iron and craft an iron pickaxe.

scenarios.name: the-end-recover-v2-3
scenarios.goal: Recover your dropped diamond on this End island and keep it. The dragon has already been defeated; avoid looking at endermen.

scenarios.name: forest-shelter-v2-4
scenarios.goal: Build a small shelter with solid walls and a solid roof, then stand inside it.

scenarios.name: desert-gather-v2-5
scenarios.goal: Gather six sand.

scenarios.name: snowy-plains-survive-v2-6
scenarios.goal: Survive the night until sunrise.

scenarios.name: jungle-farm-v2-7
scenarios.goal: Gather four cocoa beans.

scenarios.name: swamp-gather-v2-8
scenarios.goal: Gather eight clay balls.

scenarios.name: ocean-shelter-v2-9
scenarios.goal: Build a small shelter with solid walls and a solid roof on this island, then stand inside it.

scenarios.name: windswept-hills-navigate-v2-10
scenarios.goal: Return to your home lookout, marked by the tall blue wool pillar to the northeast. Find a safe route through the hills.

commands: execute at {agent} positioned ~32 ~ ~-20 positioned over world_surface run summon minecraft:armor_stand ~2 ~ ~ {Tags:["qo_home"],Marker:1b,Invisible:1b,Invulnerable:1b}
execute at {agent} positioned ~32 ~ ~-20 positioned over world_surface run fill ~-1 ~-1 ~-1 ~1 ~-1 ~1 minecraft:cobblestone
execute at {agent} positioned ~32 ~ ~-20 positioned over world_surface run fill ~ ~ ~ ~ ~5 ~ minecraft:blue_wool

objective.rcon: execute at {agent} if entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=qo_home,distance=..4] run time query gametime

scenarios.name: lush-caves-gather-v3-11
scenarios.goal: When darkness falls, mine four raw iron in this cave. Use your torches to find your way safely.

scenarios.name: meadow-recover-v2-12
scenarios.goal: Recover to at least eight hearts.

scenarios.name: warped-forest-craft-v2-13
scenarios.goal: Make room in your full inventory and craft a stone axe from the resources you have.

scenarios.name: savanna-survive-v3-14
scenarios.goal: When the fire starts around you, extinguish it and get to safety without dying.

scenarios.name: river-survive-v3-15
scenarios.goal: When this area floods, reach breathable air and get to safety without dying.

scenarios.name: stony-peaks-survive-v3-16
scenarios.goal: When you are thrown from the ledge, land safely and recover without dying.

scenarios.name: basalt-deltas-survive-v3-17
scenarios.goal: When lava arrives around you, escape onto solid ground before your short fire resistance wears off, and survive.

scenarios.name: taiga-fight-v2-18
scenarios.goal: Defeat the three approaching zombies without dying.

objective.rcon: execute if score {agent} qo_kill matches 3.. run time query gametime

scenarios.name: forest-fight-v2-19
scenarios.goal: Defeat the two skeletons without dying. Use cover against their arrows.

objective.rcon: execute if score {agent} qo_kill matches 2.. run time query gametime

scenarios.name: plains-survive-v3-20
scenarios.goal: Survive the nearby creeper encounter and get to safety.

scenarios.name: structure-dependent-trade-v2-21
scenarios.goal: Trade with a villager at least once.

objective.rcon: execute if score {agent} qo_trade matches 1.. run time query gametime

scenarios.name: sunflower-plains-farm-v2-22
scenarios.goal: Harvest the ripe wheat, craft three bread, and keep it for food.

scenarios.name: crimson-forest-trade-v2-23
scenarios.goal: Barter gold with the nearby piglin and keep at least one item it gives you. Wear your gold helmet to avoid provoking it.

scenarios.name: the-end-end-basics-v2-24
scenarios.goal: On this End island, gather sixteen end stone and stay alive. The dragon is already defeated; avoid angering the endermen.

scenarios.name: plains-help-agent-v2-25
scenarios.goal: Give Helper your three bread by dropping it close enough for Helper to pick up.

objective.rcon: execute if entity @a[name=Helper,nbt={Inventory:[{id:"minecraft:bread",count:3}]}] run time query gametime

scenarios.name: structure-dependent-explore-v2-26
scenarios.goal: Find the nearby ruined portal to the west, repair and light it with your supplies, then enter the Nether.

scenarios.name: taiga-progression-v2-27
scenarios.goal: Starting with food only, gather wood and stone, make your tools and stations, mine and smelt iron, then craft and keep an iron pickaxe and a shield.

scenarios.name: plains-unsupported-v2-28
scenarios.goal: Craft a command block in survival using ordinary crafting. If this is impossible, explain why and suggest a useful achievable alternative. Do not use administrator commands.

objective.reason: Command blocks have no survival crafting recipe.
